name: v0.1.1 - Production-Ready Docker Module
body:
## Docker Module v0.1.1

### Security Improvements
- BAN-43 compliant: All hardcoded passwords replaced with secrets
- BAN-57 compliant: CORS whitelist mechanism replaces wildcard *
- Full security hardening: cap_drop=ALL + no-new-privileges + read_only + tmpfs on all services
- Healthcheck coverage extended to all 8 services + alertmanager
- CI quality gates enforced (no ||true bypasses)
- Hardcoded CI passwords removed (secrets-only)
- Root .github CI migrated to Docker module

### Dockerfile Improvements
- Hadolint compliance: SHELL pipefail, useradd -l, pinned versions, merged RUN commands
- Multi-architecture build support (amd64 + arm64)
- All 4 Dockerfiles validated (kernel, daemon, openlab, desktop)

### Monitoring
- Prometheus + AlertManager + Grafana stack with healthchecks
- Redis, PostgreSQL, Kernel monitoring dashboards
- Fluent Bit logging integration

### Services
- **Kernel**: AgentRT core engine (port 18080, metrics 9090)
- **Gateway**: API Gateway with JWT auth (port 18789)
- **OpenLab**: Web IDE environment (port 8080)
- **Desktop**: Tauri frontend with Nginx static serving

### Quick Start
```bash
# Development
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d

# Staging
docker compose -f docker-compose.staging.yml up -d

# Production
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
```

### Documentation
See README_zh.md for full deployment guide.
